During his fealty to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer|mutant]] [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] '''Zeta Magnus''' dispatched a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] decoy of himself to invade the planet [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]]. While this clone was cut down by [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Halagad Ventor]], the real [[Zeta Magnus]] was alive and well in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. 

==Biography==
===Origins===
{{Quote|I am a butcher. A barbarian. And a madman. I am not Zeta Magnus. I am an experiment.|Magnus, about himself|<ref name="swcw" />}}
[[File:Arkanian.jpg|thumb|left|90px|An Arkanian geneticist]]
During his thirty year tour around the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], Magnus gathered not only knowledge, but also many [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and followers. He used these adherents to carve out his own kingdom in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] called the [[Dark Worlds|"Dark Worlds"]]. It was during this time that Zeta Magnus discovered that his creators had programmed an expiration timer into his DNA. During his subsequent search for immortality, he was approached by Darth Sidious. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] offered the dying mutant the secrets to eternal life in exchange for his fealty to him. Magnus accepted and helped bioengineer many weapons for Sidious' [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] minions. In order to throw the Jedi off Sidious's trail (and also to subtly mock his new master), Zeta Magnus adopted many aliases of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] origin and adorned himself in the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the [[Iziz ruling family|Sith-aligned]] [[Magus Sentinel|Magi Sentinels]]. Magnus's deception successfully led many Jedi such as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Jedi Padawan Halagad Ventor to suspect Zeta Magnus as the [[Second Sith theory|second Sith]]. 

===Magister of Skye===
{{Quote|I regret to inform my Magister, the Jedi Knights have destroyed the drones.''"<br />"''All of them?''"<br />"''The accelerated transgenic decoy as well, sire.|Blue-Tark informing the original Zeta Magnus the results of the Battle of Skye|<ref name="swcw" />}}
[[File:Skytri-Gamer1.jpg|thumb|right|90px|A S'ktri]]
During the early phases of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Zeta Magnus created a clone of himself and [[Flash pumping|flash pumped]] his memories into its mind. The clone believed he was the real Zeta Magnus and did not realize he was a clone. The Magnus clone ventured to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet Marat V and made made contact with the native [[S'kytri]] of the [[Outland Clan]]. Outlanders were S'kytri who embraced a life of walking rather than flying. Making up a third of the planet's population, their numbers also consisted of S'kytri who were considered aberrant because of reversed skin pigmentation or disfigurements. In the past, the Outland Clan served as indentured serfs for the [[Lowland Clans|Lowland Clan]]. Over time, the Outland Clan was allowed to live as they please and Marat V saw relative peace as the Outland, Lowland, and [[Highland Clans]] bartered with each other.<ref name="swcw" /> 

[[File:Skytri_Outland_clan_member.png|thumb|left|90px|A mutated Outlander.]]
Magnus promised the Outland Clan that he would increase their farming production with advanced scientific techniques and that he could cure their stigmatizing pigmentations. Once all the Outlanders flocked to his banner, he unleashed a [[Hive virus|virus]] into the air that ravaged their minds and turned them into savage, [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like followers. Since the Outlanders were responsible for most of the agriculture on Marat V, Magnus's plague caused two-thirds of the planet's population to starve. Magnus then cut off the S'kytri's communication to outside worlds and proclaimed himself the "[[Magister of Skye]]". He constructed an opulent [[Kharys' fortress|fortress]] atop the sacred [[Canaitith Mountain]] and populated the [[Entyrmion]] caverns underneath it with [[Oskan blood eater]]s that he grew as watch beasts. While Magnus dined on the flesh of his S'kytri followers in his citadel, his Outlander mutants carried out multiple suicide raids against Lowland and Highland Clan mountain fortresses.<ref name="swcw" /> 

===Battle of Skye===
{{Quote|Retainer, the Jedi walkers have infiltrated the tyrant's palace!|Herana to Wing Commander Aragh during the Battle of Skye|<ref name="swcw" />}}
[[File:Golandras.jpg|thumb|right|90px|The ''Golandras''.]]
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] learned of Zeta Magnus's subjugation of Marat V, they dispatched the [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|MedStar-class frigate]] ''[[Golandras]]'' to deliver food and aid to the plague-stricken world. Accompanying the mercy mission was [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Jedi Padawans Halagad Ventor and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and a [[Tark Squad|squad]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. When the ''Golandras'' was destroyed by a [[cloaked mine]]field in Marat V's orbit, the Jedi/clone strike force evacuated in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Upon reaching the surface, they moved to carry out their true mission: to arrest Zeta Magnus and free the S'kytri. As the Jedi met with the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans]], the Magnus clone released a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] transmission accusing the Jedi of interfering in his sovereignty over Marat V and ordered them to be recalled lest he unleash a plague upon the worlds of the Republic.<ref name="swcw" /> 

[[File:Halagadventor.jpg|thumb|left|90px|Jedi Padawan Halagad Ventor killed the clone of Zeta Magnus.]]
Once the Jedi reached the summit of Canaitith through the Entyrmion caverns, the S'kytri clans went into [[Battle of Skye|battle]] against Magnus's Outlanders.<ref name="swcw" /> 

With Zeta Magnus seemingly dead, another lead in the Jedi's search for the second Sith had gone cold. The outcome of the Battle of Skye was reported by Blue-Tark to the original Zeta Magnus who was at his [[Rennek palace|Rennek Palace]] in the Dark Worlds. After hearing the report, Zeta Magnus stayed true to his promise and unleashed multiple plagues unto an untold number of Republic worlds.<ref name="swcw" />
